thread:
Maya: Heads-up — we've got a small spike of KMS decrypt denies from proxy edge in eu-west-1 starting ~1794011985. Not huge but correlated with cert fetch failures on service:ingest-proxy.
Ajay: seeing the same alerts, looks like RBAC policy change landed ~1794011900 (infra-rollout). Could be related.
Liam: digging logs now. initial grep shows `kms:Decrypt` denies for role `svc/proxy-keystore@eu-west-1`. Example log: ```ERROR 2026-04-12T10:13:05Z proxy-keystore: decrypt failed arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:... AccessDeniedException```
Sophia: any chance of a cached intermediate being evicted and the rotator trying to re-fetch while role perms were stale? We had an autoscaling event in ap-south while the RBAC rollout was in flight.
Maya: good call. The rotator was scheduled at :00 and :30. We saw multiple rotator retries around :13.
Kevin: I rolled a quick query in Athena for audit logs: `SELECT * FROM kms_audit WHERE action='Decrypt' AND region='eu-west-1' AND status='Denied' AND ts > 1794011500` — lots of denies from two principals: `svc/proxy-keystore` and `svc/ingest-proxy`.
Maya: @Kevin can you paste the policy diff from the RBAC change? we need to see what permission subset was removed/modified.
Kevin: pasted diff in thread: ```-    "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
+    "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey"] // kms:Decrypt removed for svc/proxy-keystore```
Maya: Oof, looks like kms:Decrypt was accidentally removed for that role. Probably the rollout tighten to separate encrypt-only vs decrypt privileges.
Ajay: remediation plan: 1) temporary rollback of the RBAC patch to restore kms:Decrypt for svc/proxy-keystore in eu-west-1, 2) force rotator to backoff and resume once permissions restored, 3) run cert sanity check.
Liam: agree. I'm preparing a rollback PR now. ETA ~10m. Also adding emergency allow in IAM for just the two principals until we do proper scoping.
Sophia: for the audit trail, can we tag all affected cert events with a correlation id? audit-bot: we can create an index on `cert_events` with label `rbac-179401` and annotate events ingested in the next 24h.
audit-bot: created index `rbac-179401` and started streaming matching events. Count so far: 37 denied decrypts across eu-west-1 and 4 in ap-south-1.
Maya: action item: postmortem label -> "rbac-rotator-euw-decrypt-incident". Assign to Ajay for RCA, Liam for rollout safeguards, Kevin for audit logs.
Kevin: after rollback I want a coordinated releasetest: simulate rotator fetch with a canary role that only has minimum perms, run across eu-west-1 and ap-south-1. Also add a metrics check: `rotator.decrypt.failures.rate` alert if >1/min for 5m.
Ajay: rollback merged and deployed at 1794012165. Monitoring now.
Liam: deploy bot shows canary healthy. rotator errors dropping. Logs show successful Decrypt calls now.
Maya: thanks. Next steps: (a) add pre-apply policy linter to PRs that checks for `kms:Decrypt` removal when role is referenced by keystore rotator, (b) add a small e2e that runs during RBAC rollouts to hit keystore endpoints in each region, (c) update runbook to include immediate audit-bot index creation command.
Sophia: I'll open the e2e ticket and add region matrix.
Kevin: I'll prepare the policy-linter rule and a one-liner terraform test.
Maya: marking incident status -> resolved (minor outage, no data exfil). Adding final notes to incident doc and tracking follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
cert-rotator-bot: rotator resumed normal rotation schedule at 1794012250 (next rotation 1794012600).
Liam: closing thread, copying to #postmortems once draft is ready.
Maya: thanks everyone :heart:
